```Gateways/Setak.IMS.Blazor.UI/Pages/Laboratory/Editor.razor
@using Setak.IMS.Classes.DTOs.Reg
@using Setak.IMS.Classes.Domains.Enums
@using Setak.IMS.Classes.DTOs.Lab

<PageLoading LoadContent="(isInitialized && model != null)" @ref="loadingRef">
    <Form>
        <Validations MissingFieldsErrorMessage="خطای اعتبارسنجی" Mode="ValidationMode.Auto" ValidateOnLoad="false" Model="model" @ref="validationsRef">
            <Row>
                @* Column 1 *@
                <Column ColumnSize="ColumnSize.Is6.OnDesktop.Is6.OnTablet.IsFull.OnMobile">
                    @* ProvinceId *@
                    <Field>
                        @{
                            string elementId = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyName<LaboratoryDto>(x => x.ProvinceId);
                            string elementLabel = AttributesHelper.GetDisplayNameValue<LaboratoryDto>(x => x.ProvinceName) ?? elementId;
                        }
                        <FieldLabel For="@elementId">@elementLabel</FieldLabel>
                      
                        <ProvinceSelector AuthorizePolicy="@AuthorizePolicy" @ref="_provinceSelector"
<|editable_region_start|>
                                         OnSelectItem="OnSelectProvinceAsync"
                                         SelectionMode="DataGridSelectionMode.Single"
                                         ReadOnly="true"
                                         ShowCheckbox="false"/>
                        <Field>
                            <Validation AsyncValidator="@RequesterAsyncValidator">
                                <Addons>
                                    <Addon AddonType="AddonType.Body">
                                        <TextEdit ReadOnly="true" Text="@model.prov<|user_cursor_is_here|>"/>
                                    </Addon>

                                    <Addon AddonType="AddonType.End">
                                        <Button Color="Color.Primary" Clicked="OpenProvinceSelector">
                                            <Icon Name="IconName.Search"/>
                                        </Button>
                                    </Addon>
                                    <ValidationError/>
<|editable_region_end|>

                                </Addons>
                            </Validation>
                        </Field>

                    </Field>

                    @* Name *@
                    <Validation>
                        <Field>
                            @{
                                string elementId = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyName<LaboratoryDto>(x => x.Name);
                                string elementLabel = AttributesHelper.GetDisplayNameValue<LaboratoryDto>(x => x.Name) ?? elementId;
                            }
                            <FieldLabel For="@elementId">@elementLabel</FieldLabel>
                            <TextEdit InputMode="TextInputMode.Text" Role="TextRole.Text" ElementId="@elementId"
                                      @bind-Text="model.Name">
                                <Feedback>
                                    <ValidationError/>
                                </Feedback>
                            </TextEdit>
```
